description: Netgsm SMS — full surface (send, bulk, schedule, cancel, delivery report, sender-header list, inbox, remaining credit) over the Netgsm REST v2 + classic APIs with HTTP Basic auth. Turkish rides in the JSON body (no URL-encoding pitfalls). Built from Netgsm's official SDK (endpoints, auth and body shapes matched to it) and exercised against a mock; not yet exercised against a live account — one real send closes that gap.
author: codlook
